title: Abraham's Travels
summary: Called out of a settled city to a land he would never own, Abraham spent the rest of his life in a tent between the promise and its keeping. The only ground in Canaan he ever held was the field he bought to bury Sarah in.

summary: The anointed king spent years as a fugitive in his own country, hiding in caves and strongholds and finally among the Philistines. Many of the psalms were written on this road.

legs.name: Jerusalem
